title: Synthesis, molecular structure and magnetic behaviour of [Dy8(μ3,η2-OR)6(μ,η2-OR)4(η1-OR)8(μ,η1-OR)6] (R = C2H4OPri)

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear homoleptic Dy8 alkoxide (two tetranuclear units linked by μ,η1-alkoxides)

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1 was obtained by two routes in toluene. Direct reaction of dysprosium chips with excess 2-isopropoxyethanol under reflux in the presence of Hg2+ catalyst, followed by work-up, afforded a crystalline material analysed as Dy(OC2H4OPri)3. Alcohol-exchange of Dy5O(OPri)13 with 15 equivalents of 2-isopropoxyethanol at room temperature gave the same octanuclear cluster in nearly quantitative yield. FT-IR showed no νOH bands, consistent with a non-solvated species.
synthesis.temperature: reflux (direct Dy-chip route); room temperature (alcohol-exchange route)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution alcoholysis / alcohol exchange; crystallization after work-up
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After refluxing and work-up a crystalline material 1 was obtained; the alcohol-exchange route likewise afforded 1.

properties.summary: Solid-state susceptibility of 1 (2–300 K, 1000 Oe; χMT reported per Dy) shows room-temperature χMT = 15.05 cm3 K mol−1, slightly above the free-ion value 14.17 cm3 K mol−1, indicating essentially non-interacting Dy(III) at 300 K. Magnetization is linear in field from 1000–21000 Oe at 300 K (no ferromagnetism). χMT decreases on cooling, more steeply below 10 K, consistent with overall antiferromagnetic coupling within the tetranuclear units and a quasi non-magnetic ground state. Curie–Weiss θ = −5.3(2) K confirms weak antiferromagnetic coupling.

measurements.name: χMT (per Dy)
measurements.conditions: room temperature; data collected 2–300 K in 1000 Oe; diamagnetic correction χD = 1358.9 × 10−6 cm3 K mol−1

measurements.conditions: comparison value cited for isolated Dy(III)
